items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: Richard Benyon Allen. I didn't know that. ... Benyon. I never heard of that one.

ctx.x: Googie is the son. And I'm Dick Allen. Real name Richard Benyon Allen. Now that we're confessing on a medical truth.
Richard Benyon Allen. I didn't know that. That's the one on me, that middle one.
Well, I think it must have been a French name or something.
